t: Display → Navi: the button “Update Navi to …” only appears with a real new version number (before it sometimes showed without a version)

Navi: map scale follows the speed (Navi page: Zoom (standard), “Zoom out with speed”, from 20 km/h one step farther, from 45 km/h two steps – both adjustable). Back to the standard only 5 km/h below and after 3 s, so it does not jump
High beam also switches off by itself when disarming. Arming brings back the last level; while disarmed the button turns it on (set %)
High beam is always off after switching on (new battery). Button turns it on (set % while disarmed); after arming as before
Fix: the first line of the system log (start) showed the time 1 hour too early – now local time right away

New system log on the SD card (/log/sys.log): every start with its reason (power on, crash, watchdog, undervoltage …), Wi-Fi drop-outs with the reason code from the router, ESP-NOW restarts and a sign of life every 10 min. System → System log shows the last 80 lines
System → Online update: the status (e.g. All up to date) now sits next to the update buttons in the same look, green when up to date
Menu bar: “Firmware V2.xx” removed (version is shown under System). The green “New V2.xx” button still appears there when an update is ready
Radio for the Pi ground station / Navi restarts by itself when sending fails or the Wi-Fi mode changes (e.g. car hotspot switched off after joining home Wi-Fi)
System info: radio counters (sent, errors, restarts) for checking the ground station link

Pi ground station without Wi-Fi: the Core sends battery, temperatures, wet sensor and warning limits twice per second by radio (ESP-NOW broadcast) – the ground station hears it directly, no pairing, the Navi is not affected
Header bar: LQ (link quality) next to RSSI – green, red below the LQ warning threshold
LQ warning: only sensible values (0 = off or 20–90 %, delay 0–10 s) plus a short note which value fits
Link quality warning has its own delay: Telemetry → Radio link → Must stay below for at least (s), default 1 s, 0 = immediately (no longer the battery time). In /api/cfg and config.txt as lqWarnSek
Link quality warning moved to Telemetry → Radio link (ELRS), next to the live LQ. The LQ tile turns red below this threshold

Battery page: new setting Link quality warning below … % (default 50 %, 0 = off). If the receiver LQ stays below it for the set time: WEAK LINK x % on OSD and display. Also in config.txt and /api/cfg (lqWarnPct) for the Pi ground station
